faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for UDD Uttarakhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in UDD Uttarakhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 15 vacancies: 1 GIS Planner (GIS), 1 Lead Consultant (GIS), 1 GIS technical specialist (with GIS server management skills) & IT Expert, 6 GIS Manager, 6 GIS technical specialist (with GIS server management skills) & IT Expert (CMMU).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for UDD Uttarakhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (www.udd.uk.gov.in) and send it to Director, Urban Development Directorate, 31/62, Rajpur Road adjoining Pine Hall school, Dehradun, Uttarakhand-248001, by registered/speed post, to reach by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 60,000 for GIS Planner (GIS), 80,000 for Lead Consultant (GIS), 60,000 for GIS technical specialist (with GIS server management skills) & IT Expert, 40,000 for GIS Manager, 40,000 for GIS technical specialist (with GIS server management skills) & IT Expert (CMMU).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master in Regional Planning/Geo Informatics/Civil Engg/Computer Science/MCA/MSc Remote Sensing. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No application will be entertained in person or email.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Short listed candidates will be informed about the date and venue of interview by email/ mobile only.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on temporary basis. Services may be extended up to mission period, subject to requirement of the project and annual performance evaluation.

faq.question: Q9. Which places are covered by UDD Uttarakhand Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Dehradun, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Self-attested copy of latest CV; Educational certificates; Experience certificates.
